import { Area, AreaChart, CartesianGrid, XAxis } from '@acme/charts';
import { Button, Card, Grid, Heading, Metric, Page } from '@/components/ui';

export function OverviewDashboard({ data, onAction }: { data: any; onAction: (name: string, payload?: unknown) => void }) {
  return (
    <Page>
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => onAction('refresh')}>Refresh</Button>
      <AreaChart data={data.metrics.series} height={240}>
        <Area dataKey="revenue" stroke="#a78bfa" fill="#a78bfa" />
      </AreaChart>
      <Page />
      <Heading level={2}>Heading</Heading>
      <Grid min={240} gap="md" />
      <Card pad="lg" />
      <Metric label="Metric" value={data.user.name} />
      <Text>{data.metrics.revenue}</Text>
      <Text>{data.metrics.users}</Text>
      <Text>{data.metrics.churn}</Text>
      <Text>Revenue</Text>
      <Text>Users</Text>
      <Text>Churn</Text>
    </Stack>
    </Page>
  );
}

import { Alert, Button, Card, Checkbox, Divider, Heading, Input, Row, Stack } from '@/components/ui';

export function CheckoutForm({ data, onAction }: { data: any; onAction: (name: string, payload?: unknown) => void }) {

      <Input placeholder="Field 1" value={data.form.field0} onChange={(e) => onAction('emailChanged', e.target.value)} />

      <Checkbox checked={data.form.remember}>Remember me</Checkbox>
      <Alert tone="info">Alert</Alert>
      <Divider />

      <Text>{data.form.email}</Text>
      <Text>{data.form.card}</Text>
      <Text>{data.form.expiry}</Text>
      <Text>{data.form.cvc}</Text>
      <Text>Pay $129.00</Text>
    </Stack>
  );
}
